# Oquirrh Mountain Girls Softball (OMGS)

> Recreational girls softball league based in Riverton, Utah, for girls ages 3 to 18. Building Skills. Building Character. Building Champions.

- Divisions: T-Ball/6U, 8U, 10U, 12U, 14U, and 18U, based on birth month and year.
- Seasons: Spring (generally March through May), summer All-Stars (June 1 to early August, 8U to 18U), and Fall (generally August through October). Every team is guaranteed 10 games each season.
- Fields: Centennial Park, 13000 South 2700 West, Riverton, UT 84065 (home field); Tuscany East (Tuscany Park), 5469 W Toscana Way, Herriman, UT 84096.
- Registration: online through PlayMetrics (https://app.playmetrics.com/signup?clubToken=TG9naW4tQ2x1Yi52MS00MDM2LTE3OTgzMTY0NzF8SndCcS80SldRNVRwQzlHSU1Sc1NGUitYaUJCdEg1V09BZ1lPTVRtaGZDRT0=). Spring registration usually opens in mid-January.
- Contact: https://omgsoftball.org/contact.html. Mail: P.O. Box 385, Riverton, UT 84065-0385.
- Social: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/omgsleague and Instagram https://www.instagram.com/omgsleague. OMGS is not on X/Twitter.

- [About & Board](https://omgsoftball.org/about.html): mission, seasons, board contacts
- [Divisions & Ages](https://omgsoftball.org/divisions.html): age chart and division finder
- [Rules & Handbook](https://omgsoftball.org/rules.html): league, division, tournament, and safety rules
- [Important Dates](https://omgsoftball.org/dates.html): season dates
- [Fields & Location](https://omgsoftball.org/fields.html): addresses and directions
- [All-Stars](https://omgsoftball.org/allstars.html): eligibility, tryouts, tournaments, fee
- [Play Like a GIRL](https://omgsoftball.org/playlikeagirl.html): recognition program
- [Coaches & Parents](https://omgsoftball.org/coaches.html): handbook, slides, practices, parent info
- [Volunteer & Coach](https://omgsoftball.org/volunteer.html): coach requirements, BBQ shifts
- [FAQ](https://omgsoftball.org/faq.html): common parent questions
- [Sponsors & Partners](https://omgsoftball.org/sponsors.html): sponsors and sister leagues
- [Registration Policies](https://omgsoftball.org/policies.html): concussion, practice, sportsmanship, cancellation fee
- [Equipment Guide](https://omgsoftball.org/equipment.html): youth softball bat and glove sizing charts, batting side vs throwing hand, fitting basics; get fitted at Scheels Sandy
- [Umpiring](https://omgsoftball.org/umpiring.html): how to become a youth softball umpire; 8U umpires train with OMGS (contact Brooke Olsen, VP); 10U and up handled by D1 Prospects (contact Hadlei Weaver); D1 umpire crash course planned
- [League Family Services](https://omgsoftball.org/family-services.html): directory of services offered by league families
- [Contact](https://omgsoftball.org/contact.html): email and mailing address
